company_url.title: Company URL
company_url.description: LinkedIn company page URL. The actor also tries common slug variants if this URL is unavailable.

linkedin_email.title: LinkedIn email
linkedin_email.description: Optional. If empty, LINKEDIN_EMAIL from .env or environment variables is used.

linkedin_password.title: LinkedIn password
linkedin_password.description: Optional. If empty, LINKEDIN_PASSWORD from .env or environment variables is used.

max_pages.title: Maximum people pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of employee result pages to scrape.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Set false locally when LinkedIn asks for manual security verification.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Enable Apify Proxy for browser traffic.

proxy_groups.title: Proxy groups
proxy_groups.description: Apify Proxy groups to use when proxy is enabled.

session_id.title: Session ID
session_id.description: Stable value used for fingerprint/proxy session and stored login state.
